content.comment_body: Hello, could you assist with a problem I'm facing? I am using [product_name] [version_no] on Windows 7 Home Premium. I am unable to download or upload projects to the [product_name] module. An error appears stating: "Error while loading panel data. Java.lang.UnsatisfiedLink Error: C:\Program Files(x86)\[company_name]\[product_name] [version_no]\bin\rxtxSerial.dll: Can't load AMD 64-bit.dll on an IA 32-bit platform." I already have a programming cable from [company_name] and tried to download the upgrade for the [product_name] [version_no] 64-bit platform, but was unable to extract the file. Any help would be appreciated.

Hello [user_name], This issue is due to a mismatch between your operating system version and the rxtxSerial.dll file. If you go to your [product_name] software directory at C:\Program Files(x86)\[company_name]\[product_name] [version_no]\bin\, you can replace the rxtxSerial.dll file with one of the attached versions (remember to back up first). I have included three options; try each until the issue is resolved. Hope this helps.
Sorry, I forgot to include another alternative version of the rxtxSerial.dll file. Please find it attached.
Thank you very much! It's working now, and I was able to download my program to the [product_name] module. Really appreciate your help.
Interesting, in my case I'm running Windows Professional 64-bit on an i5 processor. The file labeled "old" resolved the issue for me. Thanks for sharing the files.

analysis.insight_summary: Users encountered compatibility problems between [product_name] [version_no] and Windows 7 Home Premium 64-bit, specifically regarding the rxtxSerial.dll file. This prevented project transfers with the [product_name] module. The error stemmed from a mismatch in the Java library and system platform architecture, causing difficulties in communicating with the hardware via the provided programming cable. The issue was resolved through community sharing of alternative rxtxSerial.dll files.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect smooth compatibility between [product_name] [version_no] and 64-bit Windows systems, with reliable upload and download operations using the official programming cable.
